Fine side lines run along the wings of the Side Line Wingback Bed, giving a winged headboard a sleeker, more designed look. The headboard and wings are deeply padded and the bed is handmade to order in Dewsbury.

Key features

  • Side line detailing along the winged headboard
  • Deeply padded headboard and wings
  • Wooden slatted base
  • Free fabric swatches

Sizes and prices

Single (3FT) £285.99; Small Double (4FT) £311.99; Double (4FT6) £324.99; King (5FT) £350.99; Super King (6FT) £402.99. Not sure which size you need? See our bed sizes guide.

Materials & build

Built on a wooden frame and upholstered by hand in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire. Fabrics: Plush Velvet, Chenille, Coniston, Naples, Galaxy and Teddy Bouclé, in solid colours, stripes or two-tone finishes, and custom requests are welcome. Free fabric swatches let you check colours at home.

Mattress

Takes a standard UK mattress in the size you choose. Browse our mattresses, such as the 3000 Pocket Sprung Mattress, to complete the bed.

Delivery, returns & warranty

We deliver free to addresses across Great Britain with our own delivery team, normally in 3-5 working days. Delivery to Northern Ireland is £90. Returns are free within 14 days for unused, unassembled items in original packaging (we collect). Faulty items are replaced free or refunded in full. Every bed has a 5-year frame warranty. Pay in instalments with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout. Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon-Fri, 9am-6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Frequently asked questions

What makes the Side Line different from a plain wingback?

The extra line detailing along the wings; the Liberty Wingback is the plain option, from £272.99.

What sizes does it come in?

Single (3FT) to Super King (6FT), from £285.99.

When will it arrive?

Delivery is free across Great Britain and usually takes 3-5 working days; Northern Ireland is £90.

Can I return it if it is not right?

Yes. Returns are free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and faulty items are replaced or refunded in full.

p1.descriptionHtml:
Short on wall space or just prefer a quieter look? The Slim Horizontal Panel Headboard keeps a low profile with neat horizontal panels on a padded surface. It is handmade to order in our Dewsbury workshop.

Key features

  • Slim, low-profile shape
  • Neat horizontal panels on a padded surface
  • Wall-mounted or fixed to a divan base
  • Made-to-measure options on request

Sizes and prices

Single (3FT) £181.99; Small Double (4FT) £207.99; Double (4FT6) £220.99; King (5FT) £259.99; Super King (6FT) £298.99. Not sure which size you need? See our bed sizes guide.

Materials & build

Padded upholstery on a wooden frame, handmade to order in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire. The product photos show a soft cream fabric; other fabrics and colours are available from our range and made-to-measure options are available on request. Free fabric swatches let you check the colour at home.

Fitting

This listing is for the headboard only. It can be wall-mounted or fixed to a divan base, so it works with a divan base you already own. Need help with fitting? Call 07417 439197 before you order.

Delivery, returns & warranty

We deliver free to addresses across Great Britain with our own delivery team, normally in 3-5 working days. Delivery to Northern Ireland is £90. Returns are free within 14 days for unused, unassembled items in original packaging (we collect). Faulty items are replaced free or refunded in full. Every headboard has a 5-year warranty. Pay in instalments with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout. Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon-Fri, 9am-6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Frequently asked questions

Is this headboard a good choice for a small bedroom?

Its slim profile takes up less visual space than a tall headboard. See our how to measure your bedroom for a new bed for planning tips.

Does it come with a bed base?

No. It is sold as a headboard, to fix to a divan base or wall-mount.

When will it arrive?

Delivery is free across Great Britain and usually takes 3-5 working days; Northern Ireland is £90.

Can I return it if it is not right?

Yes. Returns are free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and faulty items are replaced or refunded in full.

p2.descriptionHtml:
Want a complete upholstered divan set at a sensible price? The Small Line Divan Bed pairs subtle small line panel headboard detailing with a firm platform divan base, giving a clean, contemporary bedroom look. It is handmade to order in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire, from £259.99 in Single 3ft to £399.99 in Super King 6ft, with free delivery across Great Britain.

Key features

  • Small line panel headboard design
  • Firm platform divan base
  • Quality upholstered fabric throughout
  • Handmade to order in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire
  • Free fabric swatches so you can choose your colour with confidence

Sizes

  • Single (3FT): £259.99
  • Small Double (4FT): £285.99
  • Standard Double (4FT6): £299.99
  • King (5FT): £324.99
  • Super King (6FT): £399.99

Not sure which size you need? See our UK bed sizes guide.

Materials & build

Built on a wooden frame and fully upholstered by hand. Fabrics: Plush Velvet, Chenille, Coniston, Naples, Galaxy and Teddy Bouclé, in solid colours, stripes or two-tone finishes, with custom fabric and colour options available on request.

Mattress compatibility

The firm platform top takes a standard UK mattress in the size you order. Browse our mattresses, such as the 2000 Pocket Sprung Pillow Top Mattress. This base is a platform divan without built-in storage; for storage see our ottoman beds.

Customisation

Choose solid colours, stripes or two-tone, or ask about a custom fabric and colour. Free swatches are available.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Every Eagle Bed is made to order in our Pepproyd Street workshop in Dewsbury. Delivery is free across Great Britain by our own team, usually within 3–5 working days; Northern Ireland is £90. You have 14 days for free returns (we collect it free) if the bed is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging. Faulty items get a free replacement or a full refund. Every bed has a 5-year warranty, and you can spread the cost with Klarna or Clearpay.

Want drawers instead? See the Divan Storage Base with Drawers, browse all divan beds, or read divan bed vs bed frame.

FAQ

Does the Small Line Divan Bed include a headboard?

Yes, it is a divan set with a small line panel headboard.

Does it have storage?

No, it has a firm platform base. For storage choose an ottoman or drawer divan.

Can I see the fabric before I order?

Yes. Free fabric swatches are available so you can check colour and texture at home.

Is delivery really free?

Yes, across Great Britain, usually in 3–5 working days. Northern Ireland is £90.

What is your returns policy?

14 days for free returns if the bed is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging.

Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon–Fri 9am–6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Not sure on colour? Order free fabric swatches and see the fabric at home before you buy.

p3.descriptionHtml:
Storage, sound and charging in one bed. The Soho Smart Ottoman Bed hides Bluetooth speakers behind the fabric of its padded headboard and adds USB charging points on each side, so your phone charges within reach. The gas-lift ottoman base gives you a full bed's worth of hidden storage.

Key features

  • Bluetooth speakers built discreetly into the headboard
  • USB charging points on both sides
  • Gas-lift ottoman base with storage under the whole mattress
  • Fully upholstered to the floor, no exposed legs

Materials and build

Built on a wooden frame and fully upholstered by hand in our West Yorkshire workshop, with no exposed legs. Free fabric swatches are available so you can see the colour in your own light before you order.

Needs a nearby mains socket for the speakers and charging. Please ask us about the electrical specification before ordering.

Sizes available

Single (3FT), Small Double (4FT), Standard Double (4FT6), King (5FT) and Super King (6FT). Need a different size or headboard height? Ask us about a bespoke version.

Mattress compatibility

Takes a standard UK mattress in the size you choose. Browse our pocket sprung, memory foam and pillow top mattresses to complete the bed.

Delivery

Free delivery to addresses across Great Britain by our own team, usually within 3–5 working days. Let us know about stairs or tight access when you order.

Care

Vacuum gently with a soft brush attachment and blot spills straight away. Switch off at the socket before cleaning around the speakers and charging points.

Backed by our 5-year warranty. Spread the cost with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout.

Frequently asked questions

What is a square panel bed frame?

It is a bed frame with a headboard made from square padded panels, which gives the bed a structured, tailored look. This one sits on a wooden slatted base and is upholstered by hand in Dewsbury.

What style of room does the Square Panel Bed suit?

The straight, square panel lines suit minimalist and modern bedrooms best, though in a deep velvet it also works in a more traditional room.

Is the base solid or sprung?

The bed sits on a wooden slatted base, so you only need to add a mattress in the size you choose.

When will it arrive?

Delivery is free across Great Britain and usually takes 3-5 working days; Northern Ireland is £90.

Can I return it if it is not right?

Yes. Returns are free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and faulty items are replaced or refunded in full.

Can I see the fabric first?

Yes. Free fabric swatches are available, so you can see the colour in your own light before ordering.
